name: sketchy
description: Hand-drawn pencil-sketchbook slides, charts, explainers, business reports, postcards and short videos with generative sound, as self-contained HTML. Looks sketchy. The numbers are real.

interface.shortDescription: Hand-drawn slides, charts and explainers with real numbers
interface.longDescription: Makes pencil-sketchbook slides, charts, explainers, business reports, postcards and short videos with generative sound as self-contained HTML files. A built-in checker finds overflow, text under strokes and low contrast. Exports PDF, PPTX and MP4.
defaultPrompt: Make a six-slide pencil-sketch deck about our Q3 results.
Draw a hand-drawn bar chart of this CSV with real numbers.
Explain how a TCP handshake works as a sketchbook explainer.
